## High Level Overview of Change
When `sfTradingFee` is 0, `minSlotPrice = lptAMMBalance * 0 / 25 = 0`. An unowned/expired slot can be acquired for `minSlotPrice = 0`, burning zero LP tokens. While the slot provides no immediate benefit (discounted fee is also 0), if the trading fee is later voted up, the slot holder's `sfDiscountedFee` IS updated by AMMVote, so the discount tracks the new fee. However, the slot was acquired for free, meaning there was no economic cost to speculating on future fee increases. The slot holder occupies the slot for 24 hours at zero cost.

title: ci: Do not cache cargo binaries
body:
Swatinem/rust-cache deletes all pre-existing binaries in ~/.cargo/bin when saving the cache, to only cache binaries installed during the job. On persistent self-hosted runners this permanently wipes the cargo tools installed by prepare-runner (cargo-audit, cargo-llvm-cov, cargo-nextest). Set cache-bin: "false" to disable this behavior.

To make it everywhere without too much code/comments duplication, it is refactored into a separate action.

title: build: Sign RPM packages
body:
Nexus cannot sign hosted yum metadata, so the RPMs are signed before upload and clients verify them with gpgcheck=1.

sign_rpm.sh is a separate step that only runs when publishing the RPM leg, so a published RPM is always signed while local, PR and DEB builds need no key. It runs before the artifact upload, so the artifact and the published package are the same bytes.

This doesn't fix rpm upload itself, but should be merged before the fix - let's not have unsigned rpms at all.

title: refactor: Use std::format instead of boost::format where it fits
body:
## High Level Overview of Change

Converts every `boost::format` call site in the codebase over to `std::format` — 37 sites across 21 files. After this PR, `grep -rn "boost::format\|boost/format" src include` comes back empty. Also fixes three headers that turned out to be relying on `<boost/format.hpp>` arriving transitively.

### Context of Change

`std::format` validates the format string and its arguments **at compile time**. `boost::format` can only report a mismatch by throwing at run time, which for something like `STTx::getMetaSQL` (eight substitutions building a SQL row) means a formatting mistake ships and surfaces in production rather than failing the build.

Most of the conversions are mechanical — `%s`, `%d` and `%c` all become `{}`, and literal braces in `STLedgerEntry::getText` / `STXChainBridge::getText` get doubled:

```cpp
// before
return str(boost::format("{ %s, %s }") % to_string(key_) % STObject::getText());
// after
return std::format("{{ {}, {} }}", to_string(key_), STObject::getText());
```

Three places needed more than a search-and-replace, and they're the ones worth reviewing.

#### `STTx::getMetaSQL` and `Node.cpp` lose their shared `static boost::format` objects

Reusing a `boost::format` instance across calls is not thread-safe, since feeding arguments in with `%` mutates it. `getMetaSQL` had one; `Node.cpp` had four more (`kDeleteLedger`, `kDeleteTranS1`, `kDeleteTranS2`, `kDeleteAcctTrans`) as writable globals touched from `saveValidatedLedger`. They're all plain format-string constants now, with no shared state.

While converting `kDeleteAcctTrans`, note it was formatting a `uint256` through `operator<<`; it now uses the `txnId` string the surrounding loop had already computed.

Fixes a rounding vulnerability in `AMMClawback` where clawing back a fractional amount of an integer-based Multi-Purpose Token (MPT) could silently result in zero tokens being recovered, while still burning the target's LP tokens.

The guard is gated behind the `fixCleanup3_4_0` amendment.

title: fix: Allow OverrideFreeze to bypass individual/deep freeze on AMM trust lines
body:
## High Level Overview of Change

The invariant check condition:
``(!isAMMLine || globalFreeze) && hasPrivilege(tx, overrideFreeze)``
evaluates to false when `isAMMLine=true `and `globalFreeze=false`. This means `AMMClawback` cannot override individual or deep freeze on AMM trust lines (between the AMM pseudo-account and the issuer). The `withdraw()` call succeeds because it uses `FreezeHandling::fhIGNORE_FREEZE`, but the invariant checker then rejects the transaction because it detects a balance change on a frozen AMM line without the override condition being met. This creates a contradiction where the issuer's freeze action prevents their own clawback from the AMM pool.

When the issuer individually freezes their AMM trust line (via TrustSet targeting the AMM pseudo-account with `tfSetFreeze`), all subsequent AMMClawback transactions against any holder in that pool will fail at the invariant check. Combined with the fact that a frozen holder cannot withdraw via regular AMMWithdraw, this creates a freeze/clawback deadlock where LP tokens are effectively locked until the issuer unfreezes the AMM line.

## High Level Overview of Change

This does following:
- adds a useful script to init conan
- in nix devshell uses it and sets CONAN_HOME to `~/conan2-nix`
- cleans up related docs
- updates default profile, so there will be no need to add `clang 22.1` compiler inside Nix on macOS
- makes it work with direnv

Goal achieved - after `nix develop` you can run `conan install ...` straight away, 0 setup needed.
Second goal achieved - managed nix profiles inside managed (nix) environment.
